Shared strings are read once in one guarded streamed pass, bounded at 1,000,000 strings and 64 Mi characters (WORKBOOK_SHARED_STRINGS_LIMIT, refused in words).

D2: ZIP checks stay (at most 512 members; declared size against 7 GiB and stored ratio against 100, expanded bytes counted while read). Rows, windows and bytes per window and record are TABULAR_STREAM_LIMITS. TabularPin: a case-original XLSX may state up to TABULAR_STREAM_LIMITS.bytes; readTabularSource still refuses anything above 16 MiB.

D3 (review fix 1): every stored byte-range-plus-SHA pair is a real range of the original with that range's real SHA-256. For a workbook, the window (usp_table_windows byte_start, byte_end, window_sha256) and each row (byteStart, byteEnd, sha256) cite the sheet member's stored (compressed) bytes in the ZIP and the SHA-256 of exactly those bytes, computed once per sheet while the reader reads. A row also carries optional sheet, sheetSha256 (SHA-256 of the sheet's XML as read, under its own name) and marks. The window line's hash is no longer stored. AU4-B2B's evidence row locator (IntakeTableRowLocatorSchema.window) gains optional sheet, physicalRow and sheetSha256, filled for a workbook row and left out for a CSV row (all three or none).

D3 (review fix 2): a marked cell (formula with or without a cached value, error, no value) maps the way the whole read maps it: mapTableWindow emits value null, state unknown, issueCode TABULAR_CELL_UNAVAILABLE; the window proposal cell is state unknown; the evidence reader treats it as unknown and never as a key; the streamed profile treats it as having no value.

D4 (review fix 3): the private copy goes to ULPIN_DOCUMENT_OCR_SCRATCH, the private scratch setting the demo runtime gives its local readers (demo-config requires it inside the demo runtime and outside the repository). It must be absolute and outside the repository (checked before and after realpath), else 503 TABULAR_SCRATCH_UNAVAILABLE. Before copying, free space (statfs) must be at least the file's size plus 1 GiB, else 507 TABULAR_SCRATCH_SPACE in MiB/GiB words. The copy's folder (table-workbook-*) is removed in finally.
